title: Horizontal Flow Matching for Single-Cell Spatiotemporal Dynamics
abstract: arXiv:2611.24764v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Learning the spatiotemporal dynamics of cells from spatial transcriptomics requires connecting snapshots of different cells acquired in different coordinate frames. A rotation or translation of a section can appear as cell movement and distort the inferred correspondence. We introduce horizontal flow matching, which learns changes in tissue organization, molecular state, and cell abundance up to shared rigid motion. The dynamics follow a continuity--reaction equation whose action assigns no cost to shared rigid motion, and the resulting horizontal projector removes this component from spatial prediction errors during learning and from predicted velocities during generation. An equivalent endpoint problem jointly estimates correspondence and relative pose in Wasserstein--Fisher--Rao geometry and yields analytic paths whose velocity and growth serve as regression targets. Regressing these targets recovers the horizontal dynamics under id

translated_title: 面向单细胞时空动力学的水平流匹配
translated_abstract: 从空间转录组学中学习细胞的时空动力学，需要将在不同坐标系下获取的不同细胞快照连接起来。切片的旋转或平移可能表现为细胞运动，从而扭曲所推断的对应关系。我们提出水平流匹配，它能够在共享刚体运动之外学习组织结构、分子状态和细胞丰度的变化。该动力学遵循一个连续-反应方程，其作用对共享刚体运动不施加代价；由此得到的水平投影器在学习阶段从空间预测误差中、在生成阶段从预测速度中移除该分量。一个等价的端点问题在 Wasserstein-Fisher-Rao 几何下联合估计对应关系与相对位姿，并给出解析路径，其速度与增长作为回归目标。对这些目标进行回归可恢复水平动力学……（原文摘要此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出水平流匹配方法，通过在连续-反应方程与水平投影中排除共享刚体运动的代价，使得从空间转录组学数据中学习单细胞时空的组织结构、分子状态与细胞丰度变化时不受切片旋转平移等坐标变化的干扰。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces horizontal flow matching, which learns single-cell spatiotemporal changes in tissue organization, molecular state, and cell abundance from spatial transcriptomics while remaining invariant to shared rigid motions such as rotations and translations of tissue sections.
